tier1Note: Pure bug fixes, saving-throw alignment, monster immunity normalization, spellbook consistency, and scroll synchronization are always installed (Tier 1). Only opt-out system rules, added spells, balance reworks, and numeric knobs appear below.

sections.title: Core Systems
sections.description: Mod-wide stacking, summon, clone, and UI rules. Set any option to 0 to disable it.

settings.label: Typed Spell Bonuses
settings.summary: Enforce non-stacking bonus types (Morale, Favor, Luck, Dodge, Deflection, Curse); highest bonus per type applies.

settings.label: +1 Extra Attack Cap
settings.summary: Cap magic extra-attack buffs (Haste, Improved Haste, Righteous Wrath of the Faithful) to at most +1 attack per round total.

settings.label: Exclusive Transformation & Regeneration Families
settings.summary: Prevent self-transformations from stacking, pair Champion's Strength with Draw Upon Holy Might, and keep Regeneration mutually exclusive.

settings.label: Strength Floors (Never Lower Strength)
settings.summary: Turn Strength (18/50), Strength of One (18/75), Divine Power (18/00), and Champion's Strength (21) into minimum floors (with EEex; fallback without EEex).

settings.label: Lesser Restoration Without Fatigue
settings.summary: Lesser Restoration removes level drain and feeblemind without applying fatigue.

settings.label: Simulacrum & Project Image Clone Rules
settings.summary: Normalize Simulacrum and Project Image clones (60% HP/level scaling, no nested clones, contingencies, Wish, or duplicate quick items).

settings.label: Main Character Statue & Imprisonment Continuation
settings.summary: Let companions keep fighting when Player 1 is Petrified or Imprisoned, ending in defeat only when no party member can rescue them.

settings.label: Live Character Record Status Icons
settings.summary: Show live active status icons in the Character Record panel while paused or playing.

sections.title: New Divine Spells
sections.description: Six Icewind Dale and classic D&D divine spells added to cleric/druid spellbooks. Set any entry to 0 to omit it.

settings.label: Faerie Fire (Level 1 Druid)
settings.summary: Add 1st-level druid spell Faerie Fire (-2 AC, reveals invisibility, blocks stealth).

settings.label: Icelance (Level 3 Druid)
settings.summary: Add 3rd-level druid/cleric cold bolt Icelance (or normalize existing IWD Icelance).

settings.label: Protection from Cold (Level 3 Divine)
settings.summary: Add 3rd-level divine Protection from Cold (100% cold resistance for 1 turn/level).

settings.label: Protection from Acid (Level 4 Divine)
settings.summary: Add 4th-level divine Protection from Acid (100% acid resistance for 1 turn/level).

settings.label: Mass Regenerate (Level 5 Divine)
settings.summary: Add 5th-level divine Mass Regenerate (party-wide 2 HP/second for 1 round/level).

settings.label: Conjure Air Elemental (Level 6 Druid)
settings.summary: Add 6th-level druid Conjure Air Elemental with three caster-level scaling tiers.

sections.title: Spell Balance Reworks
sections.description: Individual spell and spell-group balance reworks. Set any toggle to 0 to keep that spell group vanilla.

settings.label: Faster Divine Healing & Cause Wounds
settings.summary: Give Cure spells 10 ft. reach, speed up Cure/Cause casting times (Cure Light 1 through Heal/Harm 6), and unify Mass Cure/Heal delivery.

settings.label: Fast Doom (Casting Time 1, Curse Penalties)
settings.summary: Lower Doom's casting time from 9 to 1 and focus its debuff on THAC0, damage, and saves as a Curse.

settings.label: Party Improved Haste
settings.summary: Rework Improved Haste from single-target doubled attacks into a 15-ft. party buff lasting 3 rounds + 1 round/level.

settings.label: Dispelling Screen (Breach -> AoE Dispel Protection)
settings.summary: Convert Breach into party-wide 15-ft. Dispelling Screen that intercepts one Remove/Dispel Magic.

settings.label: Halving Pierce Magic (10%-40% MR Reduction)
settings.summary: Halve the target's current Magic Resistance (clamped to 10%-40% for 5 rounds) alongside dispelling one spell protection.

settings.label: Skull Trap Damage Cap (12d6)
settings.summary: Cap Skull Trap scaling at 12d6 maximum damage.

settings.label: Scaling Chromatic Orb
settings.summary: Remove Conjurer school lock and rebalance Chromatic Orb's level-scaled damage and secondary effects (no instant-kill orb).

settings.label: Death Spell vs. Insect Swarms & Summons
settings.summary: Allow Death Spell to disperse Summon Insects, Insect Plague, Creeping Doom, and Vampire Cloud of Bats while sparing immune celestials.

settings.label: Scaling Find Familiar
settings.summary: Scale familiar HP smoothly by caster level, match familiar-granting scrolls, and prevent extreme familiar HP outliers.

settings.label: Honest Mirror & Reflected Image
settings.summary: Mirror Image no longer blocks area-of-effect spells; Reflected Image grants a single non-stacking decoy image.

settings.label: Wake on Damage (Sleep, Color Spray, PW: Sleep, Hopelessness)
settings.summary: Damage immediately wakes targets of Sleep, Color Spray, Power Word Sleep, and Emotion/Symbol Hopelessness.

settings.label: Rebuilt Polymorph Self & Shapechange Forms
settings.summary: Deliver 7 rebuilt forms each with explicit stats, weapons, abilities, and clean reversion without bogus stat overrides.

settings.label: Reworked Cacofiend, Summon Fiend & Gate
settings.summary: Fix fiend AI/allegiance scripts and balance Nabassu, Glabrezu, Cornugon, and Balor summons across arcane and divine Gate.

settings.label: Reworked Devas & Planetars
settings.summary: Rebalance Devas (3 turns, 14 HD) and Planetars (2 turns, 18 HD, no permanent Haste) with full spellbook control and death-magic immunity.

settings.label: 1 Deva + 1 Planetar Party Cap
settings.summary: Limit party-side celestial summons to at most one (Fallen) Deva and one (Dark) Planetar at a time.
